problem:
Problem description
- There is a single product planned over a finite horizon of $$T$$ periods, indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T}=\{1,2,\ldots,T\}$$.
- The planning goal is to determine the monthly purchasing and selling quantities that maximize total profit over the horizon.
- The store has a storage capacity of $$C$$ units for the product.
- The initial inventory available at the beginning of the planning horizon is $$I^{0}$$ units.
- Purchasing is allowed once at the beginning of each period, and sales occur within the same period.
- The unit purchasing cost in period $$t$$ is $$c^{\mathrm{buy}}_{t}$$.
- The unit selling revenue in period $$t$$ is $$c^{\mathrm{sell}}_{t}$$.
- Demand or market absorption in each period may be represented by the quantity actually sold in that period, denoted by $$s_{t}$$.
- Inventory carried from one period to the next is tracked so that stock balance is maintained across the planning horizon.
- The total inventory held at any time must not exceed the warehouse capacity.
- The quantity sold in each period cannot exceed the product available from initial inventory plus purchases made up to that period.
- End-of-period inventory must remain feasible and nonnegative.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{t}$$: quantity purchased in period $$t$$.
  - $$s_{t}$$: quantity sold in period $$t$$.
  - $$I_{t}$$: inventory remaining at the end of period $$t$$.
  - $$Z$$: total profit over the planning horizon.

Input Format
{
  "T": "integer, number of planning periods, indexed by $$t \\in \\mathcal{T}$$",
  "C": "nonnegative number, storage capacity of the product",
  "I0": "nonnegative number, initial inventory at the beginning of period $$1$$",
  "buy_price": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "[T]",
    "meaning": "$$c^{\\mathrm{buy}}_{t}$$, unit purchasing cost in period $$t$$"
  },
  "sell_price": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "[T]",
    "meaning": "$$c^{\\mathrm{sell}}_{t}$$, unit selling revenue in period $$t$$"
  }
}

Output Format
{
  "purchase_quantity": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "[T]",
    "meaning": "$$x_{t}$$, quantity purchased in period $$t$$"
  },
  "sales_quantity": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "[T]",
    "meaning": "$$s_{t}$$, quantity sold in period $$t$$"
  },
  "ending_inventory": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "[T]",
    "meaning": "$$I_{t}$$, inventory remaining at the end of period $$t$$"
  },
  "total_profit": {
    "type": "number",
    "meaning": "$$Z$$, maximum total profit over the horizon"
  }
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "T": 3,
  "C": 500,
  "I0": 200,
  "buy_price": [8, 6, 9],
  "sell_price": [9, 8, 10]
}

parameters.name: planning_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the finite horizon

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Inventory available at the beginning of period 0

parameters.name: buy_price
parameters.description: Unit purchasing cost in each period

parameters.name: sell_price
parameters.description: Unit selling revenue in each period

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Inventory remaining at the end of each period

constraints.name: nonnegative_purchase_quantity
constraints.description: Purchases must be nonnegative in each period.

constraints.name: nonnegative_sales_quantity
constraints.description: Sales must be nonnegative in each period.

constraints.name: nonnegative_ending_inventory
constraints.description: Ending inventory must be nonnegative in each period.

constraints.name: period_index_integrality
constraints.description: The planning horizon size must be a positive integer.

constraints.name: purchase_quantity_domain
constraints.description: Purchase quantities are continuous and nonnegative.

constraints.name: sales_quantity_domain
constraints.description: Sales quantities are continuous and nonnegative.

constraints.name: ending_inventory_domain
constraints.description: Ending inventory is continuous and nonnegative.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the finite planning horizon.

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the finite planning horizon, defined as total sales revenue minus total purchasing cost.
